why: Adds the vertical twin of the pressable width, which is the tempting symmetry and is wrong. Clipping downward is answered by scrolling -- a control below the fold is still its full size once reached, and whether it can be reached is what `reachable` already asks -- so a floor reading a viewport-clipped height would fail most of every long pane. Only the across reading is cut to the screen, because two-axis scrolling is what the layout forbids.
